notes.title: Achievements Fixed
notes.content:
Hey all,

Just a quick update to say achievements are now working. Thanks for your patience; I really appreciate it :)

notes.title: Achievements!!
notes.content:
Emi - Long Road Home has been released, but please note, achievements are currently not working. I've got a support ticket open with Steam to try and figure it out, but I didn't want to delay the release for something as simple as achievements. The game can still be played, and achievements should stack, so even if you play now and then reopen the game when achievements are working, you should still get all the ones you've unlocked.

I'll keep you updated once it's fixed.
